title: Wings — Lower Cover Spanwise Splices — Completion to the Interference-Fit Fastener Standard

ata.title: Wing Box Structure — Lower Cover Panels

abstract: Completion of the spanwise splice fastener standard on the small number of aircraft whose wings were part-built before the production cut-in, so that the whole delivery batch carries the same inspection threshold.

sections.planning_reason: The interference-fit fastener standard at the wing lower cover spanwise splices was cut in during a build period in which several wings were already partly closed. Those aircraft carry the new standard at the inboard splice but the clearance-fit standard at the mid splice, which means the extended inspection threshold in the airworthiness limitations cannot be claimed for them. The affected aircraft are known individually and the number is small. This Service Bulletin completes the mid splice so that the whole delivery batch is on one threshold.
sections.description: The mid spanwise splice fasteners in the wing lower cover are removed, the holes are cold worked to the controlled interference and the fasteners are reinstalled to the interference-fit standard with a hole quality record. The splice strap is replaced by the thicker item introduced with the standard, and the local harness route is resleeved where it crosses the reworked joint. The inboard splice, which is already at the new standard, is not disturbed.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Position the aircraft on jacks and defuel the affected tank. Open the wing box through the lower access panels in zones 532 and 633 and make the tank safe for entry. Remove the mid splice fasteners one row at a time, keeping the panel supported. Cold work each hole with the mandrel set and record the hole quality against the acceptance table. Install the thicker splice strap INN928999-53 and re-machine the interface frame D5710120386639 locally where the strap sits proud. Install the interference-fit fasteners and torque them in the sequence given. Fit the protective sleeving AGS17834-4B on the harness where it crosses the joint. Do a leak check of the tank, close the access panels and refuel. Record the embodiment and the new inspection threshold against the aircraft.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to the aircraft in the MSN M00443 to M00464 band that were part-built before the production cut-in. Aircraft outside that band are either fully at the earlier standard, where cold working an assembled wing is not practical, or fully at the new standard. This Service Bulletin is not offered as a general retrofit.
sections.material_note: Kit K5710-1029-01 contains the splice straps, the interference-fit fastener set, the sleeving and the hole quality record forms. Lead time is thirty weeks. The cold working mandrel set is loaned by Aeralis for the duration of the embodiment and must be returned; it is not part of the kit.

type_data.compliance_time: At the first scheduled tank entry, and in any case before the aircraft reaches 24 000 flight cycles.
